question: The White Paper on the five themes of Youth20 (Y20) was launched by ________ in Guwahati in February 2023.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Anurag Thakur__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Assam** to host the** first Youth20 (Y20) Inception Meeting 2023** from **Feb, 2023** in **Guwahati**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **The White Paper** on the** five themes** of** Youth20 (Y20)** was launched by **Anurag Thakur (Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports of India)** in** Guwahati** in **February 2023**.
 
• **Guwahati** is the host for the** first Youth20 (Y20) Inception Meeting 2023** from** 6th-8th Feb 2023 under G20**.
 
• The Summit provides an** opportunity for the students to voice up their opinions** for the audience worldwide.
 
• **More than 150 Youth** delegates from G20 countries are set to participate in three-day meetings.
 
• Y20 works with an aim** to provide the youth a platform to raise their concerns on contemporary issues**.
 
• The **Y20 themes** are** Future of Work: Industry 4.0**,** Innovation and 21st century; Climate Change and Disaster Risk Reduction: Making Sustainability as a Way of Life; Peace Building and Reconciliation: Ushering in an Era of No War; Shared Future: Youth in Democracy and Governance; Health, Wellbeing & Sports: Agenda for Youth**.
 
• Started in **2012**, the **Y-20 is the youth version of the G-20 Summits**.
 
• It is the **only officially recognized platform for young people** to engage with the G-20 and it is one of the **most influential international diplomatic forums** for young leaders.
 
• The **G-20 rotating presidency** bears the responsibility of** hosting the youth summit,** which usually takes place some weeks prior to the traditional forum to know what the youths are thinking and incorporate their suggestions in their own policy proposals. 
 
• It is an attempt to create a** connecting point between G-20 governments** and** their local youth**.
